from pathlib import Path
from math import ceil
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path("/home/ubuntu/repos/kev")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from kev import rounds
from kev.checkpoint import read_meta
from kev.experiment import load_plan
from kev.full_ft import snapshot_fractions
from kev.suite import digest, read_json, write_json
from r31_reuse_transfer import reuse_transfer


def verify_checkpoint(trial, config, sources, commit, suite_hash, requested_records, expected_index, warm_source=None):
    provenance = read_json(trial / "provenance.json")
    result = read_json(trial / "result.json")
    checkpoint = trial / "checkpoint"
    meta = read_meta(checkpoint)
    training = read_json(checkpoint / "training_config.json")
    metrics = read_json(checkpoint / "training_metrics.json")
    index = read_json(checkpoint / "model.safetensors.index.json")
    args = training["args"]
    expected_steps = args["epochs"] * ceil(requested_records / (args["epochs"] * args["batch"] * args["accum"] * 8))
    diagnostic_steps = sum(g["steps"] for g in metrics["grad_norm"])
    telemetry = None
    if diagnostic_steps != metrics["optimizer_steps"]:
        telemetry = read_json("/home/ubuntu/r31-resume-telemetry-proof.json")
        if not (
            telemetry["trial"] == str(trial.relative_to(ROOT))
            and telemetry["training_metrics_sha256"] == digest(checkpoint / "training_metrics.json")
            and telemetry["train_log_sha256"] == digest(trial / "train.log")
            and telemetry["git_commit"] == commit
            and telemetry["source_hashes"] == sources
            and telemetry["optimizer_steps"] == metrics["optimizer_steps"] == telemetry["expected_optimizer_steps"] == expected_steps
            and telemetry["requested_records"] == metrics["requested_records"] == requested_records
            and telemetry["actual_records_seen"] == metrics["records_seen"] == telemetry["expected_records_seen"]
            and telemetry["raw_gradient_history_steps"] == diagnostic_steps
            and telemetry["raw_timing_history_steps"] == len(metrics["step_seconds"]) == diagnostic_steps
            and telemetry["diagnostic_overcount"] == diagnostic_steps - expected_steps == 7
            and telemetry["diagnostic_statistics_valid"] is False
            and telemetry["diagnostics_quarantined"] is True
            and telemetry["native_artifacts_unchanged"] is True
        ):
            raise ValueError("resume telemetry proof does not identify these exact native artifacts")
    checks = {
        "configuration": provenance["config"] == config,
        "sources": provenance["source_hashes"] == sources,
        "commit": provenance["git_commit"] == commit,
        "suite": provenance["suite_sha256"] == suite_hash == meta.extra["suite_sha256"] == training["suite_sha256"],
        "result_provenance": result["provenance"] == provenance,
        "result_training_metrics": result["training_resources"] == metrics,
        "base": meta.base == config["base"] and meta.base_revision == training["base_revision"] == config["base_revision"],
        "full_weights": meta.weights == "full" and meta.weights_dtype == "bf16" and meta.lora == 0,
        "tensor_coverage": set(index["weight_map"]) == set(expected_index["weight_map"]),
        "weight_totals": index["metadata"] == expected_index["metadata"],
        "training_arguments": all(training["args"].get(k) == v for k, v in config.items()),
        "head_arguments": meta.extra["args"] == training["args"],
        "world_size": metrics["world_size"] == 8,
        "records": metrics["requested_records"] == requested_records,
        "records_seen": metrics["records_seen"] >= requested_records and metrics["truncated_records"] == metrics["rejected_records"] == 0,
        "completed_training": metrics["optimizer_steps"] == expected_steps and (diagnostic_steps == expected_steps or telemetry is not None),
        "no_early_stop": training["args"]["max_steps"] in (None, 0) and training["args"]["stop_after"] in (None, 0),
        "final_checkpoint": "snapshot" not in meta.extra,
    }
    if config.get("init_from"):
        checks["warm_start"] = bool(warm_source) and meta.extra.get("init_source") == training["init_source"] == warm_source
    if config.get("snapshot_fractions") == "none":
        checks["no_snapshots"] = not metrics["snapshots"] and snapshot_fractions(args["snapshot_fractions"]) == () and args["snapshot_every_steps"] in (None, 0)
    if failures := [k for k, passed in checks.items() if not passed]:
        raise ValueError(f"checkpoint verification failed: {failures}")
    return {
        "verified": True,
        "trial": str(trial.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "config": config,
        "git_commit": commit,
        "suite_sha256": suite_hash,
        "optimizer_steps": metrics["optimizer_steps"],
        "expected_optimizer_steps": expected_steps,
        "requested_records": metrics["requested_records"],
        "records_seen": metrics["records_seen"],
        "world_size": metrics["world_size"],
        "tensor_count": len(index["weight_map"]),
        "weights_metadata": index["metadata"],
        "checks": {k: bool(v) for k, v in checks.items()},
        "quarantined_resume_diagnostics": telemetry,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    spec = rounds.load(ROOT / "experiments/rounds/r31.json")
    study = spec["studies"]["r31-g31-cont2"]
    config = load_plan(ROOT / study["suite"], ROOT / study["plan"])[0]
    sources = read_json("/home/ubuntu/r31-frozen-source-hashes.json")
    commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "1fd9689"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
    suite_hash = digest(ROOT / study["suite"] / "manifest.json")
    parent = ROOT / "runs/r30-g31-full/00-trial-0"
    requested_records = read_json(parent / "checkpoint/training_metrics.json")["requested_records"]
    parent_index = read_json(parent / "checkpoint/model.safetensors.index.json")
    blend_report = read_json((ROOT / spec["arms"]["31b-blend-w85"]["checkpoint"].lstrip("/")).parent / "interpolation.json")
    warm_source = {
        "init_from": config["init_from"],
        "resolved": blend_report["sft"]["path"],
        "weights_sha256": blend_report["sft"]["weights_sha256"],
        "head_sha256": digest(parent / "checkpoint/head.pt"),
        "tensors": len(parent_index["weight_map"]),
    }

    if "--selftest" in sys.argv:
        p = read_json(parent / "provenance.json")
        verify_checkpoint(parent, p["config"], p["source_hashes"], p["git_commit"], p["suite_sha256"], requested_records, parent_index)
        print("Checkpoint verification passes on the existing round-30 final fixture.")
        raise SystemExit(0)

    launch = rounds.launch_arm_reads

    def verified_launch(spec, arm, **options):
        try:
            proof = verify_checkpoint(ROOT / spec["arms"][arm]["trial"], config, sources, commit, suite_hash, requested_records, parent_index, warm_source)
            header_proof = "/home/ubuntu/r31-cont-tensor-headers.json"
            subprocess.run([
                "uv", "run", "modal", "run", "/home/ubuntu/r31_verify_headers.py::main",
                "--checkpoint", f"/runs/{spec['arms'][arm]['trial'].removeprefix('runs/')}/checkpoint",
                "--parent", config["init_from"], "--out", header_proof,
            ], cwd=ROOT, check=True, timeout=300)
            proof["actual_tensor_headers"] = read_json(header_proof)
            proof["transfer_reuse"] = reuse_transfer(spec, arm)
        except Exception as error:
            raise rounds.Unmapped(f"checkpoint not verified; do not read it: {type(error).__name__}: {error}") from error
        write_json("/home/ubuntu/r31-cont-verification.json", proof, atomic=True)
        print(f"{arm}: checkpoint/configuration/provenance verified before short reads", flush=True)
        return launch(spec, arm, **options)

    rounds.launch_arm_reads = verified_launch
    rounds.watch(spec)

import hashlib
import json
import math
import struct
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import modal

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ubuntu/repos/kev")
import modal_app as research

app = modal.App("kev-r31-header-verification")
image = research.image.add_local_file(
    "/home/ubuntu/repos/kev/modal_app.py", "/root/modal_app.py"
)


def tensor_schema(checkpoint):
    index = json.loads((checkpoint / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text())
    tensors = {}
    total_size = 0
    for name in sorted(set(index["weight_map"].values())):
        path = checkpoint / name
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            header_size = struct.unpack("<Q", stream.read(8))[0]
            if header_size > 16 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise ValueError("invalid safetensors header size")
            header = json.loads(stream.read(header_size))
        intervals = []
        for key, value in header.items():
            if key == "__metadata__":
                continue
            if key in tensors or index["weight_map"].get(key) != name:
                raise ValueError(f"unexpected/duplicate tensor or incorrect shard: {key}")
            start, end = value["data_offsets"]
            itemsize = {"BF16": 2, "F32": 4}[value["dtype"]]
            if end - start != math.prod(value["shape"]) * itemsize:
                raise ValueError(f"tensor shape/dtype disagree with payload: {key}")
            intervals.append((start, end))
            total_size += end - start
            tensors[key] = {"shape": value["shape"], "dtype": value["dtype"]}
        cursor = 0
        for start, end in sorted(intervals):
            if start != cursor or end < start:
                raise ValueError(f"noncontiguous tensor data in {name}")
            cursor = end
        if path.stat().st_size != 8 + header_size + cursor:
            raise ValueError(f"incorrect shard byte size: {name}")
    if set(tensors) != set(index["weight_map"]):
        raise ValueError("actual safetensors do not cover the index")
    if total_size != index["metadata"]["total_size"]:
        raise ValueError("tensor payload bytes disagree with index")
    return tensors, index["metadata"]


@app.function(
    image=image, cpu=1, memory=1024, timeout=180,
    volumes={research.RUNS_MOUNT: research.runs_volume.with_mount_options(read_only=True)},
)
def verify(checkpoint, parent):
    from kev.checkpoint import Checkpoint
    from kev.suite import digest, read_json

    tensors, metadata = tensor_schema(Path(checkpoint))
    expected, parent_metadata = tensor_schema(Path(parent))
    if tensors != expected or metadata != parent_metadata:
        raise ValueError("final tensor shapes/dtypes/coverage differ from registered parent")
    measured = read_json(Path(checkpoint).parent / "result.json")["provenance"]["measured_checkpoint"]
    weights_sha256 = Checkpoint(checkpoint).weights_sha256()
    head_sha256 = digest(Path(checkpoint) / "head.pt")
    if (weights_sha256 != measured["weights_sha256"]
            or head_sha256 != measured["head_sha256"]
            or measured["inference_temperature"] != 1.0):
        raise ValueError("actual final weights/head differ from the native measured checkpoint")
    return {
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "parent": parent,
        "tensor_count": len(tensors),
        "dtype_counts": dict(Counter(t["dtype"] for t in tensors.values())),
        "actual_tensor_elements": sum(math.prod(t["shape"]) for t in tensors.values()),
        "metadata": metadata,
        "tensor_schema_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(tensors, sort_keys=True).encode()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "actual_shards_cover_index": True,
        "actual_shapes_dtypes_match_parent": True,
        "actual_shard_sizes_match_tensor_offsets": True,
        "actual_weights_sha256": weights_sha256,
        "actual_head_sha256": head_sha256,
        "actual_payload_hashes_match_measured_checkpoint": True,
    }


@app.local_entrypoint()
def main(checkpoint: str, parent: str, out: str):
    from kev.suite import write_json
    result = verify.remote(checkpoint, parent)
    result["verification_app_id"] = app.app_id
    write_json(out, result, atomic=True)
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True), flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

ROOT = Path("/home/ubuntu/repos/kev")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from kev import rounds
from kev.benchmark import prediction_rows, summarize
from kev.checkpoint import read_meta
from kev.data import api_request, materialize
from kev.model import encode
from kev.suite import CONTEXT, digest, load_split, read_json, read_jsonl, read_manifest, record_digest, write_json


def reuse_transfer(spec, arm, write=True):
    entry = spec["arms"][arm]
    trial = ROOT / entry["trial"]
    study = next(value for name, value in spec["studies"].items() if entry["trial"].startswith(f"runs/{name}/"))
    tag = rounds.transfer_read(spec, arm)
    registered = spec["reads"][tag]
    if registered.get("flags") or registered.get("entrypoint"):
        raise ValueError("saved transfer cannot replace a read with different flags or entrypoint")
    suite = ROOT / registered["suite"]
    if (ROOT / study["transfer"]).resolve() != suite.resolve():
        raise ValueError("in-trial transfer suite differs from the registered read")
    source = trial / "transfer"
    destination = ROOT / rounds.locations(entry.get("reads", spec["arm_reads"]), spec, arm=arm, size=rounds.size_of(arm))[tag]
    result = read_json(trial / "result.json")
    report = read_json(source / "report.json")
    suite_hash = digest(suite / "manifest.json")
    if result["transfer"]["suite_sha256"] != suite_hash:
        raise ValueError("saved transfer manifest differs from the frozen suite")
    calibration = report["calibration"]
    if calibration["inference_temperature"] != 1.0 or not calibration["logits_recorded"]:
        raise ValueError("saved transfer is not raw-logit scoring at T=1")
    rows = read_json(source / "rows.json")
    records = load_split(suite, "development")
    coverage = report["coverage"]
    if any(coverage[key] for key in ("truncated_records", "rejected_records")):
        raise ValueError("saved transfer rejected or truncated records")
    expected_questions = sum(len(record["questions"]) for record in records)
    if (coverage["requested_records"] != len(records) or coverage["requested_questions"] != expected_questions
            or coverage["evaluated_records"] != len(records) or coverage["evaluated_questions"] != expected_questions):
        raise ValueError("saved transfer coverage differs from the frozen development partition")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(trial / "checkpoint", local_files_only=True)
    meta = read_meta(trial / "checkpoint")
    context = read_manifest(suite).get("context", CONTEXT)
    recorded_rows = []
    for record, prediction in zip(records, read_jsonl(source / "predictions.jsonl"), strict=True):
        if prediction["id"] != record["_meta"]["id"] or prediction["request_sha256"] != record_digest(api_request(record)):
            raise ValueError("saved prediction request differs from a frozen transfer record")
        encoded = encode(tokenizer, materialize(record), max_state=context["max_state"], max_branch=context["max_branch"],
                         strict=True, option_isolation=bool(meta.extra["args"]["option_isolation"]))
        if len(encoded["ids"]) > context["max_packed"] or len(encoded["ids"]) != prediction["prediction"]["input_tokens"]:
            raise ValueError("saved prediction encoding differs from the registered read context")
        reconstructed = prediction_rows(record, prediction["prediction"])
        if reconstructed != prediction["rows"] or any(row.get("inference_temperature") != 1.0 or "logits" not in row for row in reconstructed):
            raise ValueError("saved raw rows differ from their prediction records")
        recorded_rows.extend(reconstructed)
    if recorded_rows != rows or len(rows) != expected_questions:
        raise ValueError("saved rows differ from the complete prediction stream")
    measured = result["provenance"]["measured_checkpoint"]
    if measured["head_sha256"] != digest(trial / "checkpoint/head.pt") or measured["inference_temperature"] != 1.0:
        raise ValueError("transfer scoring did not use the verified final head at T=1")
    proof = {"reused_from": str(source.relative_to(ROOT)), "rows_sha256": digest(source / "rows.json"),
             "suite_sha256": suite_hash, "registered_directory": str(destination.relative_to(ROOT)),
             "records": len(records), "questions": len(rows), "inference_temperature": 1.0,
             "measured_checkpoint": measured, "environment": result["provenance"]["environment"],
             "requests_encodings_predictions_and_raw_rows_verified": True, "new_model_calls": 0}
    if not write:
        return proof
    if (destination / "rows.json").exists():
        if digest(destination / "rows.json") != proof["rows_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("registered transfer already contains different rows; never overwrite or reread")
        return proof
    destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    final_report = summarize(rows, heldout_sources=tuple(read_manifest(suite)["holdout_sources"]))
    final_report.update(coverage=coverage, latency_ms=report["latency_ms"], calibration={**calibration, "additional_temperature": 1.0},
                        suite_sha256=suite_hash, split="development", rotations=1, date_facts=False, data=None,
                        run=rounds.checkpoint_of(entry), calibration_applied=False, environment=proof["environment"],
                        remote=None, reuse=proof)
    write_json(destination / "report.json", final_report, atomic=True)
    write_json(destination / "reuse.json", proof, atomic=True)
    temporary = destination / ".rows.json.pending"
    shutil.copyfile(source / "rows.json", temporary)
    temporary.replace(destination / "rows.json")
    return proof
